content_sections.heading: About NITK
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Karnataka, Surathkal, Mangaluru – 575025 describes itself as an Institute of National Importance, established by the NITSER Act, 2007 under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The notice is issued by the Establishment and General section and signed by the Dean (FSW). It is dated 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Institute is looking for Postgraduates in Library and Information Science from recognized Indian universities. The essential qualification is Master's in Library & Information Science (M.L.I.Sc.) or equivalent with First Class. Final year students whose results are awaited can also apply, but their result must be declared before the interview. Persons with good communication and interpersonal skills, and with enthusiasm and passion to learn new skills and deliver services using emerging tools and technology, will be preferred. The age limit is not exceeding 26 years. Relaxations for SC, ST, OBC (NCL) and PwD category candidates apply as per Govt. of India rules. The notice does not print a date as on which age is counted. Those who have already undergone training in the Institute need not apply again.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The Library Trainee receives a consolidated stipend of Rs.15,000/- per month. The traineeship runs for eleven (11) months and is purely on a temporary basis. The nature of the traineeship is to learn while working on different functions and services of the library. Selected candidates will have to work six days a week and shall work in different shifts and on weekends on a rotation basis. The Institute has no obligation to absorb the trainees at the end of the training, and the Library Trainees will be relieved at the end of the training period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NITK LIBRARY TRAINEE
content_sections.text: Fill up the prescribed application form available on the Institute website, www.nitk.ac.in . Applications are accepted in offline mode only. Attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents (listed below). Put the complete application in a sealed cover and send it by Speed Post. Address the cover to: Deputy Registrar (Administration), National Institute of Technology Karnataka (NITK), Surathkal, Srinivasnagar Post, Mangaluru – 575025. Write clearly on the envelope: "Application for the Post of LIBRARY TRAINEE". Make sure the application reaches the Institute by 04-12-2026 before 05:00 P.M. Detailed Bio-data All certificates and mark sheets of the qualifying examinations (10th, 10+2, UG, PG) Experience certificate issued by the Competent Authority, or any other relevant certificates/testimonials Proof of date of birth (SSLC / Birth Certificate) Government-issued ID (Aadhar card / Pan Card / Voter ID) Community certificates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS) and certificates for persons with disabilities (PwD) as per Govt. of India norms, as applicable. OBC (NCL) candidates must attach the latest Non-Creamy Layer certificate, issued on or after 01-04-2026. Transgender candidates must attach a certificate / identity proof issued by the Government / Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has three stages: scrutiny of applications, a written examination, and a personal interview and/or skill test, as applicable. Applications will be scrutinized based on the candidates' academic credentials and records. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to take a written examination. The notice does not state the pattern, marks or date. The written examination is followed by a personal interview and/or skill test, as applicable. Originals along with self-attested photocopies of the certificates must be produced if called for the selection process. Candidates should check www.nitk.ac.in regularly for updates and notifications.

faq.question: Q1. How many Library Trainee vacancies has NITK announced?
faq.answer: NITK Surathkal has announced Five (5 Nos.) Library Trainee vacancies at its Central Library.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NITK Library Trainee?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Institute by 04-12-2026 before 05:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NITK Library Trainee?
faq.answer: Master's in Library & Information Science (M.L.I.Sc.) or equivalent with First Class. Final year students awaiting results can apply, but the result must be declared before the interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 26 years, with relaxations for SC, ST, OBC (NCL) and PwD candidates as per Govt. of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for the Library Trainee?
faq.answer: The consolidated stipend is Rs.15,000/- per month for the eleven (11) month traineeship.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NITK Library Trainee?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form from the Institute website and send it with self-attested documents by Speed Post in a sealed cover to the Deputy Registrar (Administration), NITK, Surathkal, Srinivasnagar Post, Mangaluru – 575025. Only offline applications are accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the Post of LIBRARY TRAINEE" clearly on the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized on academic credentials and records. Shortlisted candidates take a written examination, followed by a personal interview and/or skill test, as applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Library Trainee post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary for eleven months, and the Institute has no obligation to absorb trainees at the end of the training period.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the selection process?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates during the entire selection process.
